question.text: Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) is a method of disguising proceeds of crime by moving value through trade transactions. Which of the following correctly identifies the three main methods of laundering money?

answer.text: Through the financial system, through physical movement of banknotes, and through false documentation and declaration of traded goods and services
Through the financial system, through cryptocurrency exchanges, and through false documentation of traded goods
Through physical movement of banknotes, through shell companies, and through offshore accounts
Through the financial system, through physical movement of banknotes, and through real estate transactions

explanation.text: The Logic: The three main methods for moving illicit value are: (1) movement through the financial system, (2) physical movement of banknotes, and (3) movement using false documentation and declaration of traded goods and services. TBML specifically exploits the third method. The Trap: Cryptocurrency, shell companies, offshore accounts, and real estate are vehicles used in money laundering, but they are not the three main categories. Narrowing the third category to traded goods only omits services. Note: The third method covers both traded goods and services.
